scope: One fresh Claude workflow and independent source/relocated Windows game; not whole Alpha, stable runtime API, production graphics or a success-rate benchmark.

provider.name: Claude Code
provider.assistance: Frozen general SDK/docs, discovery, file tools, owned Python-script MCP executor forwarding actual native CLI/JSON-RPC, existing-image observation. No supplied game implementation or grader feedback.
provider.isolation_limit: Trust-based workspace/process ownership, not a filesystem/network security sandbox. Shared warmed NuGet cache and installed toolchain remain.

task.content: Native box primitives; no imported or generated art/audio/models.

checks: Native movement, camera rays and compiled Use collect two useful bounded item types.
Closed shutter actually occludes the drive cog; breaker opens its kinematic collider and permits pickup.
One-fuse breaker rejection preserves full chosen inventory/progression and settled body matrices.
Fuses are consumed once; the carried cog is consumed to raise a real walkable bridge; native controller crosses it and starts the pump.
Repeated completed interactions preserve chosen inventory/progression and settled mechanism poses.
Compiled Save completion is checked against native ticket ledger and durable payload identity/checksum.

Eight before-callback comparisons preserve the complete same-format native snapshot/document and complete chosen entity/UI/registry/schema/value projections. Only top-level session envelopes are omitted from those projections.
Four first-restored-callback checks predict all 25 typed globals from actual owner epoch, LastRestore and camera ray; original ticket epochs and saved tick remain.
Cold owners invoke the actual Welcome Load control, restore before callbacks and complete through native gameplay.
Four New Game checks begin from completion, reset five body poses and progress within 60 ticks, preserve every external store byte, allow a real reset pickup and load the old full checkpoint again.

rendered_observation.inspection: Objective, inventory, feedback and save status are legible. Text wraps within words; partial/completed views are very close to geometry. Functional greybox, not an art/graphics-quality demonstration.

failures_retained.cause: Supervisor sampled a NuGet scratch entry after concurrent removal; outer Windows Job forcibly closed remaining descendants. No terminal provider verdict.

failures_retained.verdict: six failed script attempts retained inside successful original workflow
failures_retained.cause: Agent repairs and rejected contract/route attempts remain in original logs; native process exit does not imply all RPCs or assertions passed.
Plan included unrelated >256 MiB editor C ABI DLL; existing bounded file admission rejected it. Next plan omits that non-CLI dependency, with verifier/game bytes unchanged.

limits: This closes the bounded puzzle/adventure family composition, not all Alpha gates or broad genre support.
The public fixture is a source/evidence record. Its original complete project/artifacts are retained locally; portable source-record rebuild is not qualified.
The generated launcher omits external save storage; the documented game-run command requires an existing --save-root directory outside the bundle.
Game serve, compiled controls and Vulkan snapshot capture are qualified here; interactive game run, physical input, listening and clean-machine installation are separate.
Source/export campaigns use different actual module locations and owners; full-save equality is checked within each campaign, not invented across unrelated owner epochs.
No performance, representative memory, hardware-range or cross-engine/provider comparison follows.
Runtime compatibility remains prospective beyond the separately released authoring-core v1.

qualification_helper_tests.scope: Pure temporary-filesystem/mocked/parser checks, separate from native game execution.
